title: Drop and Contact
author: Wendell Oyelaran
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
